items.text: Ashton Jeanty questionable (foot and ankle); Raiders elevated RB Roman Hemby from practice squad.
items.why: DNP Friday after limited Thu; foot added to ankle; elevation signals prep for absence.
items.implication: GTD; if OUT, lead role to Mike Washington Jr with Hemby depth.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup snaps if inactive; monitor for role expansion

items.text: Steelers officially placed WR Michael Pittman Jr. on IR due to foot injury; will miss minimum of four games.
items.implication: Out at least through Week 8+; opens PIT WR targets.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/routes for other PIT WRs

items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of WR Marvin Harrison Jr.; informed he will be inactive vs Lions Sunday as details wrapped. Houston among teams in mix; wanted 1st-round value.
items.why: Trade imminent per sources; team comfortable enough to sit him knowing deal near.
items.implication: Immediate zero; long-term move to new team (HOU interest for Stroud reunion).
items.opportunity: Opens targets for remaining ARI WRs

items.text: Saquon Barkley OUT (hamstring) along with Tank Bigsby (IR); DeVonta Smith and Hollywood Brown also OUT for Eagles in London.
items.why: Final Friday board; hamstring keeps him out of London game.
items.implication: Will Shipley primary back; elevated Dameon Pierce depth. Zero for Barkley/Smith.
items.opportunity: Shipley goal-line/snap share; TE Goedert (IN) as top Hurts target

items.text: Lamar Jackson OUT; Tyler Huntley to start for Ravens.
items.why: Ankle; confirmed on final board and reports.
items.implication: Major QB downgrade; Huntley start impacts all BAL pass catchers/Henry script.
items.opportunity: Possible more Henry volume; Flowers Q status key

items.text: MHJ has just 5 catches in 4 games and wasn't a real factor; post-trade/inactive it is Kia Kendrick Bourne szn. Low recent impact braces Bourne/Wilson opportunity.
items.why: Production data: minimal involvement even before trade.
items.implication: Wilson and Bourne elevated in ARI passing game immediately.

items.text: Chris Olave, Jayden Daniels, Dallas Goedert, Jeremiyah Love all IN (cleared/removed from report or expected).
items.why: Final Friday board lists as IN.
items.implication: Full or near-full roles expected; reverse any prior benching.

items.text: Key QUESTIONABLE: Ja'Marr Chase (concussion), Justin Jefferson, Tee Higgins, Ashton Jeanty, Ladd McConkey, Zay Flowers, Rhamondre Stevenson, Alvin Kamara, Terry McLaurin. Messy list per Levitan.
items.why: Friday final board; many full or limited but tagged.
items.implication: Sunday AM decisions critical; high variance.
items.opportunity: If OUT, beneficiaries in each room (e.g. CIN WRs, etc.)

items.text: Breece Hall OUT (another week), Stefon Diggs OUT, Quentin Johnston OUT, Michael Pittman OUT (later IR).
items.implication: Allen lead for Jets; WAS WR depth; LAC WR2+ open; PIT IR confirmed.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love not on final injury report (IN) despite ankle maintenance; projected 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier. Post-Week 4 usage criticism may bump role; still some downside risk if long year.
items.why: Cleared final report; gut for much better role after fan/media drag on prior usage.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex with workload edge; Allgeier secondary.
items.conflict: Ankle still a factor for possible sudden limit

items.text: Malik Nabers multi-risk stack long-term: knee becomes real issue, can't shake shoulder, JJ McCarthy under center, coaching (Harbaugh/Nagy/Roman) boomer it up. No designation this week but monitor.
items.why: Stacked injury + QB/coaching risks despite great talent; frustration on targets noted.
items.implication: This week fine (no tag) but ROS caution; not pure smash.
items.conflict: Elite talent vs multiple failure modes

items.text: Loves Nico Collins @ TEN as WR8; volume including red zone vs soft pass defense.
Loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; workload + defense carved by RBs; ties to possible CIN WR injuries boosting checkdowns.
Hates Jalen Hurts vs JAX in London as QB15; rough stretch + banged-up line.
items.why: Efficiency concerns and OL issues in tough spot.
items.implication: Sit/fade if better options; lower ceiling.
